$comment: FINALIZED pt-v1.3 — ADDITIVE bump of the frozen pt-v1.1 contract and the pt-v1.2 additive copy (schema/tool_contracts/paper_trade_step-v1.1.json and -v1.2.json, neither of which is edited). Scope: the clock-free per-5m-bar paper-trading step (P1 intraday plan, todo 2; closes GAP-2/GAP-6/GAP-7). Additions only (REQUIREMENTS §9: additive = minor bump): every request-side field below is OPTIONAL, so a pt-v1.2 request stays valid, and the five result-side keys (bar_time/order_events/open_orders/order_seq/slippage) are gated on schema_version == 'pt-v1.3' and are NEVER in the result's top-level required list. A pt-v1.1/pt-v1.2 document remains valid against its own file; this additive file also keeps such a document valid (their keys and conditionals are preserved verbatim). The dependency-free validator in agent/src/tools/paper_trade/schema.py implements a keyword subset (type/const/enum/required/properties/items/additionalProperties/dependentRequired) and deliberately ignores the version-gated allOf/if/then block; it DOES enforce dependentRequired, so bar_time must accompany order_events/open_orders/slippage. pattern/format/minLength/minimum/exclusiveMinimum/uniqueItems are documentation for the real jsonschema library, which can consume this standard draft-2020-12 document; the fail-closed gate for those is parse_bar_step_request in schema_v13.py.

request.title: paper_trade_step pt-v1.3 bar-step request — additive overlay (P1 todo 2)
request.$comment: ADDITIVE request overlay only: a pt-v1.3 bar step carries the pt-v1.2 identity/session fields (account_id/market/account_state/from_date/to_date/fee_model/interval/session/path_model/fill_model, documented on BarStepRequest) PLUS the optional fields below. Every field here is optional so a pt-v1.2 payload with none of them still validates — no request addition is ever required by this document. additionalProperties stays true because the overlay does not re-declare the base fields. bar_time is semantically mandatory for a bar step (parse_bar_step_request rejects a missing one) but is not marked required here: requiring it would break a pt-v1.2 request, and the parser is the fail-closed gate. The pt-v1.2 batch channels orders/strategy_path are rejected by the parser for a v1.3 bar step.

bar_time.$comment: Aware Asia/Shanghai (+08:00) minute label with zero seconds. The caller supplies the clock — the package never reads a wall clock. Any other offset, a naive datetime, or non-zero seconds is rejected by parse_bar_time.

action.$comment: One flat discriminated shape: parse_order_action enforces the action-specific invariants (place: symbol+side+qty and no caller order_id; cancel/replace: order_id or client_order_id and no qty/limit/side; replace: replace_qty and/or replace_limit).

order_actions.$comment: Per-bar order intents in application order; replaces the pt-v1.2 orders/strategy_path batch channel.

cancel_order_ids.$comment: Bulk cancel channel by order_id. Duplicates and empty strings are rejected by parse_bar_step_request; a target may appear only once across order_actions/cancel_order_ids/replace_orders.

replace_orders.$comment: Dedicated replace channel: every row MUST carry action='replace' (const). parse_order_action still enforces the target and replace_qty/replace_limit invariants.

bps.$comment: A JSON number or a plain decimal string (no exponent, NaN or Infinity); parsed into Decimal at the boundary.

amount.$comment: A JSON number or a plain decimal string (no exponent, NaN or Infinity); parsed into Decimal at the boundary.

slippage.$comment: Explicit adverse execution-price model. Exactly one knob may be non-zero, matching the model: none => bps==amount==0; fixed_bps => amount==0 (bps defaults to 10); fixed_amount => bps==0. parse_slippage rejects unknown keys and a mismatched knob.

slippage_model.$comment: Shorthand form of slippage.model. Mutually exclusive with the slippage object.

slippage_bps.$comment: Shorthand form of slippage.bps: a JSON number or a plain decimal string.

slippage_amount.$comment: Shorthand form of slippage.amount: a JSON number or a plain decimal string.

session_phase.$comment: Phase the clock classified for this bar. Only 'continuous' matches orders; '' (absent) means the caller did not classify and the clock layer derives it from bar_time — never silently treated as continuous.

limit.$comment: Required but nullable: a market order carries null, a limit order a positive price.

status.$comment: 'new' is the only non-terminal state; filled has remaining_qty == 0 and new implies remaining_qty > 0 (parse_order_state).

items.$comment: Order-book row (same shape as result.open_orders). filled_qty defaults to 0, avg_fill_price to 0, seq to 0 and client_order_id to '' — those four are the only optional members.

open_orders.$comment: The carried order book before this bar (open and terminal rows). parse_order_state enforces quantity conservation, terminal/new status invariants and unique order_id/client_order_id; order_seq must exceed every carried seq.

order_seq.$comment: Next free deterministic per-account order sequence; the engine embeds it in order_id as '...:<seq:08d>'.

prev_closes.$comment: Optional previous-session daily close per symbol, the band input for the cn_a limit_up/limit_down slots. An integer is CENTS (100000 = 1000.00); a float/Decimal is yuan and is normalized onto the 0.01 tick. Absent means the band is UNKNOWN and the band slots are skipped (never fabricated).

schema_version.$comment: Which version a response emits (same D8 presence rule as pt-v1.2): 'pt-v1.1' when every new request field is at its default (byte-identical to the frozen v1.1 document, no v1.2/v1.3 keys at all); 'pt-v1.2' for a day-level v1.2 call; 'pt-v1.3' only for the per-bar bar-step surface, where the five v1.3 keys are mandatory (see allOf). A 'pt-v1.1' or 'pt-v1.2' document remains governed by its own file.

received_state_hash.$comment: sha256(JCS(non-order inputs)) — AM-4/R7; 64 lowercase hex. The v1.3 bar-state coverage (open_orders/order_seq/bar_time/slippage) is owned by state_hash.compute_bar_state_hash; a v1.1/v1.2 call hashes exactly as before.

effective_fee_model.$comment: Full echo of the fee parameters in effect (R7-3). Default key names FROZEN per APPROVAL note 5 / REQUIREMENTS §4: cn_a = commission_rate 0.00025, commission_min 5.0, stamp_tax_sell 0.0005, transfer_fee 0.00001; hk = commission_rate 0.0003, commission_min 3.0, stamp_tax_rate 0.001, regulatory_levy_rate 0.00003; us = commission_per_share 0.0049, commission_min 0.99, sec_fee_rate 0.0. Per-key merge keeps the object open by design.

reason.$comment: VD-15: orders mode = empty string; strategy_path mode = strategy reason text truncated to <=200 chars (UTF-8 safe). For a pt-v1.3 bar step this is the order-action reason text.

reason_code.$comment: AM-14 closed vocabulary (11) — FROZEN, unchanged by pt-v1.2/pt-v1.3.
T3 emergency cancel: one row per failed order in 5m mode (D2). Never added to the frozen rejected_orders vocabulary.

canceled_orders.$comment: pt-v1.2 only. Emitted (possibly empty) for a v1.2 call; omitted entirely for a pt-v1.1 call, which stays byte-identical (D2/D8). A v1.3 bar step composes the v1.2 result document and therefore carries it too.

event_type.$comment: Session facts (T4, D2). halted = calendar says open, the 5m fetch succeeded, another symbol has bars that day, and this symbol has zero bars for the session (D6).

events.$comment: pt-v1.2 only. Emitted (possibly empty) for a v1.2 call; omitted entirely for a pt-v1.1 call (D2/D8). A v1.3 bar step composes the v1.2 result document and therefore carries it too.

reason.$comment: AM-14 closed vocabulary (2): non_trading_day = cn_a only (CH calendar truth); market_closed_inferred = hk/us only, always accompanied by a warning (AM-6)

warnings.$comment: deterministic English strings, never contain timestamps (VD-7 / R1 hard semantics 1)

source.$comment: AM-9 merged-frame form for cn_a, e.g. 'clickhouse+tencent(merged)'

ratio.$comment: clean hit = ratio label (e.g. '4:1'); unresolved = the observed close-to-close ratio as a decimal string (fail-closed fact, never a guess)

detected.$comment: true = clean split applied; false = unresolved fail-closed rejection (corporate_action_unresolved)

limit_provenance.$comment: VD-11 cn_a limit/ST/suspension path tokens, '<symbol>@<date>:<token>' — token set frozen (limits_cn_a.py): limits:stk_limit / limits:heuristic / limits:unavailable / st:stk_st_daily / st:stk_st_daily-no-row / suspend:stk_suspend / suspend:stk_suspend-no-row / limit_list:stk_limit_list_d. Present only for cn_a runs that consulted the band seam

data_provenance.$comment: Extension set FINALIZED at G1: AM-9 merge-state fields (ch_as_of/network_as_of/bars_as_of), T4 corporate_actions, VD-11 limit_provenance. Optional fields are omitted when unset, never null.

engine_fingerprint.$comment: sha256(JCS({interval, path_model, fill_model, rules_version, bar_fingerprint})) as lowercase hex. pt-v1.3 extends the fingerprint input with slippage_model/order_model_version (state_hash work, P1 todo 3). Out field only — it never changes matching.

bar_time.$comment: pt-v1.3 only (P1 todo 2): canonical echo of the request bar_time — the aware +08:00 minute label this result belongs to. Emitted only for a pt-v1.3 document; absent for v1.1/v1.2.

event_type.$comment: ORDER_EVENT_TYPES in schema_v13.py — one shared vocabulary for every later module. placed/canceled/replaced/filled/rejected/expired, in occurrence order.

reason_code.$comment: Machine-readable rejection/expiry reason; the closed vocabulary is owned by the order book (todo 8+), not pinned here.

order_events.$comment: pt-v1.3 only (P1 todo 2): ordered lifecycle facts of THIS bar. Emitted (possibly empty) for a pt-v1.3 result; absent for v1.1/v1.2.

limit.$comment: Required but nullable: a market order carries null, a limit order a positive price.

status.$comment: 'new' is the only non-terminal state; filled has remaining_qty == 0 and new implies remaining_qty > 0 (parse_order_state).

items.$comment: Order-book row (same shape as request.open_orders). filled_qty defaults to 0, avg_fill_price to 0, seq to 0 and client_order_id to '' — those four are the only optional members.

open_orders.$comment: pt-v1.3 only (P1 todo 2): the carried order book AFTER this bar (open and terminal rows), same row shape as request.open_orders. Emitted (possibly empty) for a pt-v1.3 result; absent for v1.1/v1.2.

order_seq.$comment: pt-v1.3 only (P1 todo 2): next free deterministic per-account sequence after this bar. Emitted for a pt-v1.3 result; absent for v1.1/v1.2.

bps.$comment: Decimal STRING, never a float — e.g. '10', '0'. Money never leaves the engine as a JSON float.

amount.$comment: Decimal STRING, never a float — e.g. '0.05', '0'.

slippage.$comment: pt-v1.3 only (P1 todo 2): canonical echo of the applied SlippageSpec (SlippageSpec.as_wire). Emitted for a pt-v1.3 result; absent for v1.1/v1.2.

allOf.$comment: Preserved verbatim from paper_trade_step-v1.2.json: the three v1.2 keys are mandatory ONLY for a pt-v1.2 document, so v1.1/older documents stay valid under this additive file. The dependency-free validator ignores if/then/allOf; wire.build_success_payload enforces the same rule in Python.

Version-gated requirement (P1 intraday plan todo 2): the five v1.3 keys are mandatory ONLY for a pt-v1.3 document and are deliberately absent from the result's top-level required list, so a pt-v1.1/pt-v1.2 document still validates here. The dependency-free validator defers this if/then gate to the wire builder (as in v1.2) but DOES enforce the dependentRequired guard above, so a v1.3 document with order_events (or open_orders/slippage) and no bar_time is rejected by validate_payload.

code.$comment: AM-14 closed vocabulary (2 + transport reserved): PAPER_DATA_NOT_READY = retryable (RM 30min x 3); INVALID_REQUEST = non-retryable. Transport-level MCP errors are reserved for engine-internal faults. Unchanged by pt-v1.3.

account_id.$comment: verbatim echo even on the error path (AM-4-4/AM-5)

received_state_hash.$comment: present only when the received account_state was parseable (AM-4-4); omitted otherwise, never null — RM reads the absence as 'state unparseable' and must not burn its retry chain

message.$comment: deterministic English, no timestamps (VD-7). Frozen formats include strategy_execution_timeout:{YYYY-MM-DD} and strategy_execution_error:{YYYY-MM-DD}:{exception class} (VD-8/B1, Step 7). pt-v1.3 adds the bar-step gates (bar_time phase/offset, order-action invariants, slippage model).
